message.reasoning_content: Sell 2 at 12+10=22 cash. But cash devalues in round 3? cash=floor(cash/100)*62 — cash loses 38%. Promissory pays full next round... promissory added at start of round and then next devaluation applies too. Actually start of round: cash devalued, then promissory added. Promissory doesn't devalue until the round after. Sell credit gives 1.25x, added to cash next round start after devaluation of old cash — so promissory effectively skips one devaluation. Sell credit is better.
